# Step 63: 9" wire from right strip lug 4 (S) to solder lug near filter cap

> *Connect one of a 9" wire to lug #4 (S) of the right screw terminal strip. Connect the other end to solder lug near capacitor.* — manual page 10

## What you're doing physically

A 9" wire from lug 4 of the right 4-screw terminal strip to the main ground lug. The strip end is soldered (S); the ground lug stays unsoldered for step 64.

Lug 4 of the right strip is now soldered final.

## What this completes

Mirror of [step 61](step-61-left-strip-4-to-ground.md). The right speaker's common terminal is now tied to chassis ground at the star ground point.

After steps 61 and 63, **both speaker commons are at chassis ground**. Speakers can be safely connected to either channel without ground-loop concerns.
